title: First event
summary: Assign elapsed time to the first qualifying event during the inclusive risk window, capped by death and observation end. Prior outcomes are excluded relative to effective entry. Single-row follow-up stops on the last observed day before a gap; events in unobserved gaps do not count. Zero elapsed days is possible when entry and exit coincide.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
